result.summary: Found 2 issues: a critical data-display bug showing €NaN for delivery, and a major layout overflow clipping a restaurant name.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows “€NaN delivery” instead of a valid price, indicating a missing or failed numeric value.
issues.suggestion: Handle missing/invalid delivery fees with a fallback (e.g. “Free”, “Price unavailable”, or omit the fee) and never render NaN to users.

issues.description: The third “Fastest near you” card title is clipped: “Trattoria Piccol” is cut off at the right edge of the card.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the title with wrapping, ellipsis, or a smaller type size so the full restaurant name stays visible within the card.
